text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With the arrival of the new year, I went to visit the shrine for Hatsumode together with Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The roads are pretty empty around New Year's, so I thought
about going for a drive, but...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It just wouldn't feel like the New Year without making a shrine visit, would it~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Besides, they say "New Year's Day is the time to make your plans for the year,"
so I figured I'd pray for the fulfillment of my goals this year.
choice_data_list: So what's your goal gonna be?
What are you going to set as your goal?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fufu, my goal this year is to run in lots of fun races.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I have to shine waaaay more than before
and become someone they'll want to chase after!"
choice_data_list: I'll make sure to support you properly.
I'll make sure to give you full support.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
As expected of my Trainer-kun!
I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
As expected of my Trainer-chan!
I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So, what specifically should we be doing
in order to reach our goal?
choice_data_list: I guess it's the basics—managing your condition.
I guess it's about honing your greatest strength.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
They say "a safe horse is a great horse,"
so being mindful of your physical condition is definitely important.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Got it! I'll pay even closer attention
to my physical condition from now on!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's go ahead and
finish our shrine visit!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I see, so training all-round
levels you up a step, huh!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me, I'll keep it in mind during training too.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, now that that's settled,
let's get our shrine visit done!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: If we're talking about my best weapon, it's gotta be my brilliant driving technique!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding, psych!
You mean polishing our running skills, right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'll try to keep that in mind during training too.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Now, shall we go ahead and
finish our shrine visit?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Now that we've visited the shrine,
the New Year is finally underway.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, Maruzen-san!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year~
I look forward to working with you again this year.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you too!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hii, Happy New Year☆
Are you guys here for Hatsumode too?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's like this every year,
but there are wicked lots of people—I feel like I'll get lost!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Even Spe-chan, who breaks away from the pack in races,
can't handle festival crowds, huh? Heheh!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer-kun, did you know?
About what these two achieved.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer-chan, did you know?
About what these two achieved.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Since your debut, you've racked up great results
and are even being called part of the Golden Generation, you know?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... That's a bit embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Seeing my sweet juniors do so well
makes me so happy as their senior~♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "The reason we've been able to grow this far is thanks to having someone to push us to our limits."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "Acknowledging each other's running and striving to surpass it is what brought us to where we are today."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, even if I lose, I'll just prove myself next time! That's the spirit!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And it wasn't just my classmates
who helped me grow.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: This year, I was hoping to surpass the back of the one I've admired since before my debut~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, could that be...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Maruzensky-san.
Would you run a race with me?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, my!! To think the shrine's blessing would take effect so quickly!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaat!?
G-Grass-chan, are you serious!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Even though I feel like I still have so far to go
compared to Maruzen-san...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Saying you're not there yet...
Don't you think that's not true?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And like Grass-chan said,
having a rival really is the best.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I believe you can only keep running because
you have rivals to measure yourself against and push each other higher.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: E-Elevating each other...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: So holding back would be a total waste!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Grass-chan, let's race together
and push each other to greater heights!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the Yasuda Kinen in June—
I will take on the challenge there.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'll be looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa... Grass-chan, you're incredible...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu~n♪
This is shaping up to be a fun year~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Of course! Running with my junior is bound to be a blast!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, by the way, have you decided on your next target race?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Even if you run against Grass-chan in June,
it's not like you aren't entering any races until then, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of course, so she can run more exciting races,
entering competitions with many formidable rivals—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Here it comes, the big spring race!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm gonna blaze beneath
the cherry blossoms at full throttle!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, with target races decided,
a brand new year with Maruzensky began.
